effects.title: Effects
effects.subtitle: Choose the animation that plays when an idea is dispatched to an agent.
effects.library_hint: Plays when an idea is dispatched to an agent. Hover or focus a card to preview it; click to apply immediately.
effects.follow_workspace_hint: Turn off to pick an effect for this project only
effects.note_workspace: Used by projects that follow this workspace.
effects.note_following: Following the workspace: changes to the workspace effect apply here too.
effects.scope_hint: Open a workspace to choose its effect.
effects.sources_hint: Each source can use its own effect. All follow the selection above by default.
effects.source_voice_sub: Ideas spoken into the command bar
effects.source_idea_sub: Clicked or dragged from the idea list onto a card
effects.source_handoff_sub: One agent passes a task to another
effects.speed_hint: Only changes flight and impact duration, not the dispatch itself
effects.save_failed: Couldn't save the effect. The previous choice has been restored.
effects.line_meteor: A white spark gathers, then dashes into the card and bursts into a ring.
effects.line_ion: A spark with a helical trail flies to the target card, used for hand-offs between agents.
effects.line_plane: Folds into a paper plane, glides and banks, then lands on the title bar with a check mark.
effects.line_ribbon: The spoken waveform unfurls into a ribbon and settles on the card as equalizer bars.
effects.line_firefly: Lights rise and gather, then drift into the card and glow one by one.
effects.line_fireworks: A rocket climbs and bursts into a two-tone chrysanthemum above the card; embers crackle down.
effects.line_lightning: Charges up, then a forked bolt strikes the card and arcs crawl along its edge.
effects.line_vortex: Stardust spins into a small galaxy, spirals to the card and collapses into a flash.
effects.line_random: Picks a different effect for every dispatch to keep things fresh.
effects.run_hint: How agent cards look while thinking, running tools, waiting for you, done or failed. Shared by all projects; changes apply to cards on the canvas immediately.
effects.run_preview_hint: Click the preview card to mark it viewed.
effects.run_line_classic: A light snake circles the border while working; the border breathes while waiting; a soft glow stays until you view the result.
effects.run_line_underline: Only the line under the title moves: a glint while thinking, a flash per tool, a full green line when done.
effects.run_line_aura: A slow spectral glow around the card edge; its color is the state.
effects.run_line_ferrofluid: A film of liquid metal wraps the card: spikes while working, a pulsing drop while waiting, drips on failure.
effects.global_hint: Applies globally to all workspaces and projects.
